core: Growth hormone axis and somatic growth control
name: Growth hormone axis with somatostatin and glucagon-family receptors
rationale: All members concern growth hormone signalling, secretion and organismal growth regulation; unlike the confusables (which add prolactin, thyroid hormone or IL-6-family cytokines) this theme adds somatostatin and glucagon-type GPCR/adenylate cyclase control.

core: Embryonic planar polarity and left-right asymmetry
name: Embryonic planar polarity and Nodal-driven left-right asymmetry
rationale: Members cover planar cell polarity, convergent extension and left-right axis specification with Nodal regulation and extracellular ligand sequestration; the confusables share PCP/Hedgehog components but lack the left-right asymmetry and Nodal arm.

qualifier: control of transcription factor DNA binding
name: Transcriptional repression by control of promoter DNA binding
rationale: Members share negative regulation of transcription and of transcription factor DNA binding/promoter occupancy; confusables are gene-specific transcription programmes (CDH1, RUNX3, PAX3, BMP) rather than this generic DNA-binding control.

qualifier: phospholipid remodeling plus triglyceride and lipid droplet dynamics
name: Glycerophospholipid and triglyceride metabolism with lipid droplet dynamics
rationale: Members span glycerophospholipid synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling, triglyceride/DAG/MAG turnover and lipid droplet biology; confusables lack either the phospholipid arm (fatty acid/glycerol themes) or the triglyceride/lipid droplet arm (sphingolipid/membrane lipid theme).

core: Global-genome nucleotide excision repair of UV damage
name: UV lesion recognition and incision in global-genome excision repair
rationale: All members concern UV-induced pyrimidine dimer recognition and dual incision in GG-NER and UV responses; confusables cover transcription-coupled NER, gap filling or translesion synthesis instead.

core: Endocardial cushion and atrioventricular valve formation
name: Endocardial cushion EMT and atrioventricular valve formation
rationale: All members concern endocardial cushion epithelial-mesenchymal transition, fusion and mitral/tricuspid valve development; confusables cover outflow tract/semilunar valves or chamber and septum morphogenesis.

core: Innate recognition of bacterial cell-wall lipids
qualifier: TLR2/TLR4 sensing of LPS, lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid
name: TLR2/TLR4 detection of bacterial lipopolysaccharide and lipopeptides
rationale: Members concern detection of LPS, diacyl lipopeptide and lipoteichoic acid via CD14/TLR2/TLR4 with resulting inflammatory leukocyte chemotaxis; confusables cover NOD-like peptidoglycan sensing or generic myeloid TLR modules.

name: Aurora A regulation and mitotic centrosome maturation
rationale: Members cover AURKA activation/degradation, PLK1 regulation and recruitment/loss of centrosome proteins at mitotic entry; confusables address spindle orientation, centriole duplication or NEK kinases without the AURKA regulation arm.

name: Neuronal migration, cortical lamination and forebrain commissure formation
rationale: Members concern radial and tangential neuron migration, cortical layering/regionalization and commissural tract morphogenesis; confusables cover neuroblast division, cerebellar layering, spinal patterning or reelin/dendrite signalling.

qualifier: threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation of ERK, JNK and p38
name: MAPK feedback inactivation by threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation
rationale: Members concern dual threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation and negative feedback silencing ERK, JNK and p38 with AP-1 output; confusables cover MAPK activation (TAK1, IL-6) or serine phosphorylation and ERK5/atypical MAPK.

qualifier: endoderm and early gut tube morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation, germ layer formation and early gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, EMT and cell migration at gastrulation, mesendoderm/endoderm specification, lateral mesoderm and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis; confusables are pancreatic lineage or cardiac mesoderm programmes.

name: Sodium-phosphate cotransport and Klotho-FGFR phosphate homeostasis
rationale: Members concern type II Na+/Pi cotransporters and their disorders, phosphate transport and its hormonal (PTH, Klotho-FGFR) control; confusables cover ectopic calcification, dental mineralization or vitamin D metabolism.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and E-cadherin turnover
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly/maintenance and CDH1 trafficking, degradation and cleavage; confusables cover apical-basal polarity, desmosomes/hemidesmosomes or EMT regulation.

name: Neuronal and astrocytic glutamate transport
rationale: All members concern glutamate reuptake, transport and homeostasis including glutamate transporter disorders; confusables concern GABA/glycine transmission or aspartate transport.

name: BRCA1-BARD1 and BRCA2 loss in double-strand break response
rationale: Members concern defective or negatively regulated DSB response through BRCA1/BARD1 loss and impaired BRCA2 (DSS1 binding, nuclear import); confusables cover downstream HR steps, PALB2 defects, NHEJ or end resection.

qualifier: IGF-driven FOXO inactivation and FOXO-dependent apoptosis
name: AKT-mediated FOXO regulation downstream of IGF signaling
rationale: Members concern AKT inactivation and localization/acetylation of FOXO, FOXO target transcription and IGF/hormone responses; confusables add mTORC1, p53 metabolic, glycolytic or NFE2L2 programmes.

name: Neurotrophin signaling through TRK receptors and p75NTR
rationale: Members are NGF/BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 signalling via TRKA/B/C and p75NTR to RAS-MAPK, PI3K, PLCG1 and death pathways; confusables are semaphorin/ephrin axon guidance and regeneration themes.

qualifier: E2F-RB G1/S control, replication licensing and APC/C regulation
name: Cell cycle transitions via E2F-RB, replication licensing and APC/C
rationale: Members cover E2F/RB-driven G1/S transcription, origin licensing and replication initiation, checkpoints and APC/C-controlled mitotic exit; the closest confusable instead centres on mitotic/meiotic chromosome and spindle mechanics.

core: Amino acid and oligopeptide transmembrane transport
qualifier: cationic amino acid and proton-oligopeptide carriers
name: Amino acid and peptide transport including cationic amino acid carriers
rationale: Members concern transmembrane transport of amino acids and di/oligopeptides with cationic amino acid (arginine, lysine, ornithine) transporters and their disorders; confusables centre on neutral/imino acid transporters, renal solute carriers or polyamine/inositol transport.

name: Urea cycle and inherited urea cycle enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Members are the urea cycle, citrulline/arginine biosynthesis and the NAGS, CPS1, OTC, ASS1, ASL and ARG1 deficiencies; confusables cover arginine/ornithine transport, arginine catabolism or broader nitrogen metabolism.

name: Renin-angiotensin peptide processing and blood pressure control
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation and signalling, bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism and renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure, volume and sodium excretion; confusables cover glomerular filtration, vasopressin water balance, natriuretic cGMP or aldosterone.

name: Rho, Rac and Cdc42 GTPase cycles and actin effectors
rationale: Members are the GTPase cycles of many Rho, Rac, Cdc42 and atypical Rho family members and their actin-nucleating effectors driving lamellipodia; confusables cover RND3/Rac inhibition, macropinocytosis or downstream actin filament mechanics.

core: Nuclear noncoding RNA processing and decay
name: Nuclear exosome RNA decay, surveillance and tRNA maturation
rationale: Members concern 3'-end processing and exosome-mediated decay/surveillance of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, CUTs and mRNA plus tRNA processing and small RNA biogenesis; confusables cover RNA modification, rRNA cleavage/ribosome assembly or mRNA splicing and transcription.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport and membrane cargo targeting
name: Intraflagellar transport and ciliary membrane cargo targeting
rationale: Members concern IFT, BBSome and ARL13B/VxPx cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body docking; confusables cover cilium disassembly/centriole control, motile cilia assembly or photoreceptor outer segments.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven recruitment and respiratory burst
name: Neutrophil recruitment and respiratory burst with formyl peptide receptors
rationale: Members concern granulocyte chemotaxis, formyl peptide receptor signalling, respiratory burst, degranulation and myeloid inflammatory modules; confusables cover microbial killing, extravasation, chemokine production or Fc receptor signalling.
